violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the bar and main kitchen dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Call was made for service at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment... - The gaskets to the cold drawer unit were observed ripped/torn and in need of replacement - The faucet to the 3 bay sink was observed to be dripping/leaking when in the off positions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
